devices.name: Digital Multimeter
devices.summary: Handheld meter for measuring voltage, current and resistance, and testing continuity.

devices.name: Analog Multimeter
devices.summary: Needle-type meter for measuring voltage, current and resistance, read from a printed scale.

devices.name: Digital Clamp Meter
devices.summary: Clamp-on meter that measures current through a conductor without breaking the circuit, plus voltage and resistance.

devices.name: Digital Oscilloscope
devices.summary: Bench instrument that displays how a voltage changes over time, used to view, time and measure signals.

devices.name: Function Generator
devices.summary: Bench source that produces sine, square, ramp and other test waveforms with adjustable frequency, amplitude and offset.

devices.name: DC Power Supply
devices.summary: Bench source that provides an adjustable DC voltage with an adjustable current limit to power circuits under test.

devices.name: Soldering Station
devices.summary: Temperature-controlled soldering iron station for joining components to circuit boards.

devices.name: LCR Meter
devices.summary: Instrument that measures inductance, capacitance and resistance, plus quality factor and dissipation factor.

devices.name: Insulation Tester
devices.summary: High-voltage tester that measures insulation resistance in megohms and checks low-resistance continuity.

devices.name: Breadboard / Digital Trainer
devices.summary: Bench trainer with solderless breadboard, 5 V supply, logic switches, LEDs, display and clock for building digital circuits.
